preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 200,000.
The length of the sequence must match the specified number of elements n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if any(a.count(x) > 2 for x in set(a)) else True
postconditions.description: If any element appears more than twice, output 'NO' as it cannot be split into strictly increasing and decreasing sequences.
If output is 'YES', the total number of elements in the increasing and decreasing sequences must equal n.

postconditions.expression: all(inc[i] < inc[i+1] for i in range(len(inc)-1)) and all(dec[i] > dec[i+1] for i in range(len(dec)-1))
postconditions.description: The increasing sequence must be strictly increasing and the decreasing sequence must be strictly decreasing.
